assets.expected_view: Pointed at the MIM arm and work table from the operator PC.
assets.label: Dave PC camera
assets.verification_rule: The operator PC reports a usable camera, but remote MIM may use it as current visual evidence only after a PC camera bridge or capture endpoint provides a fresh frame.

assets.expected_view: Wide room view for object, table, arm, and human context.
assets.label: MIM Box whole-lab camera
assets.verification_rule: Use as a current external lab/table view after confirming its physical aim for the active task.

assets.expected_view: Operator-facing camera for identity/context, not primary object localization.
assets.label: MIM Box operator camera
assets.verification_rule: Use for operator context after confirming physical aim; do not use as object-location truth unless it sees the work surface.

assets.expected_view: Set-back view of the arm and table for pickup alignment.
assets.label: Pi set-back arm camera
assets.verification_rule: MIM must discover/open this feed before citing it as external arm-view evidence.

assets.expected_view: Camera mounted on the hand, upright, wide view; moves with the grip.
assets.label: Pi hand camera
assets.verification_rule: Use for close alignment and grip contact, but never as the only localization source when the target is outside its frame.

hard_asset_policy.access: MIM has full lab access to these assets for learning, perception, and interaction.
hard_asset_policy.arm_object_interaction_rule: For table approach, cube proximity, or object pickup, MIM must use multi-view localization: hand camera plus at least one external observer camera when available, with C12 distance and RPLIDAR as supporting sensors.
hard_asset_policy.staleness_rule: Stale detections or old camera artifacts cannot be used as current target-location truth.
hard_asset_policy.truth_rule: MIM must not claim a camera is live, current, or used until a fresh frame/openability check succeeds.

operator_facing_summary: MIM has five declared hard lab camera assets. Currently verified in the MIM runtime: mim_box_lab_camera, mim_box_operator_camera, pi_hand_camera. Bridge or endpoint work still needed: dave_pc_arm_camera, pi_arm_observer_camera.

required_for_blue_block_pickup.completion_gate: MIM cannot complete pickup from resource binding alone; completion requires fresh multi-view localization, bounded motion evidence, contact/grip evidence, and operator-facing result.
minimum_before_motion: fresh external arm-observer frame or explicit blocked_with_evidence for every external camera path
